{{Citation}}
A '''heavy cruiser''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]]. Following the [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|Anaxes War College System]] of starship classification, heavy cruisers were medium sized [[Starship/Legends|starships]] at a size of roughly 600 - 1000 meters. They were much larger than [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] or [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] but smaller than ships of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] or [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] classification.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==History==
Long before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], heavy cruisers were among the largest starships of the Galaxy. But that changed, when the Clone Wars and the [[Rise of the Empire era|Rise of the Empire]] forced a radical mobilization and militarization throughout the whole galaxy and larger, more powerful ships, like the Star Destroyers, were constructed.

==Role==
Heavy cruisers were often the backbone of any fighting fleet as they fulfill many important roles. Such roles included planetary bombardment, troop transport, and ship to ship combat.

However, most heavy cruisers were not equipped with [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Therefore, they were in need of smaller support craft like frigates, corvettes, and carriers, taking starfighters into battle.
